title: 美银乔虹：通胀回落与AI热潮，经济结构如何重塑？
speaker: Helen Qiao

segments.en: So PPI inflation in our view has already picked out from 4.3% in June and you know recently a three handle and probably back into two and CPI inflation was struggle to get back towards the 1% level.
segments.zh: 我们认为，PPI通胀已从6月的4.3%回落，近期降至3%左右，可能进一步回到2%。而CPI通胀则难以回升至1%的水平。

segments.en: We see that probably it would range somewhere between 0 to 0.5.
segments.zh: 我们预计CPI通胀可能在0到0.5之间波动。

segments.en: Getting more depressed actually with the tone apart from exports what what else is doing well.
segments.zh: 整体基调更显低迷，除了出口，还有哪些领域表现较好？

segments.en: Export is the most notable and also I would say the derivatives as you said it related to AI development because those models are not necessary for export right but they also benefit.
segments.zh: 出口是最显著的亮点，此外，与AI发展相关的衍生领域也表现不错，这些模型不仅用于出口，也带来了额外收益。

segments.en: I think those are the highlights but I think it's a little bit risky to call education because you have a very narrow kind of.
segments.zh: 这些是亮点，但将其称为教育领域可能有些风险，因为范围非常狭窄。

segments.en: A very strong arm of the key exactly the arm is actually pretty thin right then the leg is extremely long and thick.
segments.zh: 就像一只手臂很强壮，但实际上手臂很细，而腿却又长又粗。

segments.en: And at the moment I think that we're still seeing predominantly the gross deceleration in most sectors.
segments.zh: 目前，我们仍看到大多数领域出现整体放缓。

segments.en: Yeah it's a T-Rex if you imagine. Oh that's a good one.
segments.zh: 是的，你可以想象成一只霸王龙。这个比喻不错。
